content.json:
# SQL Database Logs

Azure SQL diagnostics covering query performance, deadlocks, connection failures, DTU/vCore utilization, and security audit events.

content.query:
// Top long-running queries by average duration
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.SQL'
| where Category == 'QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics'
| summarize
    AvgDurationMs = avg(duration_d),
    MaxDurationMs = max(duration_d),
    ExecutionCount = sum(count_executions_d)
    by query_id_d, Resource
| top 20 by AvgDurationMs desc
| project Database = Resource, QueryId = tostring(toint(query_id_d)), AvgDurationMs = round(AvgDurationMs, 1), MaxDurationMs = round(MaxDurationMs, 1), ExecutionCount = toint(ExecutionCount)
content.title: Top 20 Slowest Queries (Avg Duration)

content.query:
// Query execution count trend over time
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.SQL'
| where Category == 'QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics'
| summarize TotalExecutions = sum(count_executions_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Resource
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Query Executions Over Time

content.query:
// DTU / CPU / IO utilization from AzureMetrics
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.SQL'
| where MetricName in ('dtu_consumption_percent', 'cpu_percent', 'physical_data_read_percent', 'log_write_percent')
| summarize AvgValue = avg(Average) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), MetricName, Resource
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: DTU / CPU / IO Utilization Over Time

content.query:
// Connection and storage usage
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.SQL'
| where MetricName in ('connection_successful', 'connection_failed', 'storage_percent')
| summarize AvgValue = avg(Average) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), MetricName, Resource
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Connections & Storage Utilization

content.query:
// SQL errors by error number and database
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.SQL'
| where Category == 'Errors'
| summarize ErrorCount = count() by error_number_d, Resource, Message
| top 20 by ErrorCount desc
| project Database = Resource, ErrorNumber = toint(error_number_d), Message = substring(Message, 0, 120), ErrorCount
content.title: Top SQL Errors

content.query:
// Deadlocks over time
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.SQL'
| where Category == 'Deadlocks'
| summarize DeadlockCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Resource
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Deadlocks Over Time

content.query:
// SQL security audit events — failed logins and permission denials
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.SQL'
| where Category == 'SQLSecurityAuditEvents'
| where action_name_s has_any ('DATABASE_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED', 'FAILED_DATABASE_AUTHENTICATION_GROUP')
| summarize FailCount = count() by server_principal_name_s, client_ip_s, Resource
| top 20 by FailCount desc
| project Database = Resource, Principal = server_principal_name_s, ClientIP = client_ip_s, FailCount
content.title: Failed Authentication Attempts
